items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcWFBIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--dcb1cc31fe570b2e92ff6833b471e00724cc3465/IMG_3453.jpeg) **Skewbragon 2024** Bienvenido a una competencia oficial organizada en conjunto por [Team CDMX](https://www.facebook.com/TEAMCDMX) y [Team Querétaro.](https://www.facebook.com/teamrubikqro) **Skewbragon 2024 es una competencia totalmente gratuita gracias al patrocinio de[ Brick Cubes](https://www.facebook.com/BrickCubes)**. *Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial de Cubos. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia.* **Esta es una competencia gratuita, al registrarte aceptas cumplir con las actividades de staff que te serán asignadas.** Welcome to this competition hosted by [Team CDMX ](https://www.facebook.com/TEAMCDMX)and [Team Querétaro](https://www.facebook.com/teamrubikqro). **Skewbragon 2024 is a free competition thanks to [Brick Cubes](https://www.facebook.com/BrickCubes) sponsorship**. *This competition is recognized as World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiarized with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)* **This is a free competition, by registering, you agree to perform all staff tasks assigned to you**.

venue.address: Via di Calvola 2/1, 34143 Trieste TS, Italy

items.information: Please, avoid wearing shoes that can damage the gym floor (e.g. heels) **Athletic shoes are recommended** The organizers reserve the right not to let in those who wear shoes deemed unsuitable. **Note: you will have to pay extra at the venue €10 if you are not a Cubing Italy member. It's free, discover how to in the [Registration tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TriesteSpeedcubing2024#39004-registration-registrazione-faq).** --- Si raccomanda di non indossare scarpe che possono danneggiare il pavimento della palestra (esempio: scarpe con i tacchi) **Si consigliano scarpe da ginnastica** Gli organizzatori si riservano il diritto di non far entrare coloro che indosseranno calzature ritenute non idonee. **Nota: dovrai pagare altri €10 in loco se non ti associ a Cubing Italy. È gratis, scopri come nella [sezione Registrazione](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TriesteSpeedcubing2024#39004-registration-registrazione-faq).**
